title: Bounty Hunter
description: A feature rich bounty system with pooled rewards, crossplay support, and anti exploit protection.
body:
### 🎯 BountyHunter

Place bounties on players, pool rewards, and hunt them down for profit.
BountyHunter is a PvP bounty plugin for Paper 1.21 servers with full Vault economy
integration, optional WorldGuard safe zones, and Geyser/Floodgate crossplay support.

---

## ✨ Features

- **Pooled bounties** — multiple players can contribute to the same target's bounty pool
- **Bounty expiry** — bounties expire after a configurable time (default: 48h) with partial refunds
- **Extend bounties** — pay a small fee to keep your bounty alive longer
- **Wealth gate** — prevents low-balance players from piling onto high-value targets
- **Placement cooldown** — stops spam bounties on the same player
- **Safe zones** — WorldGuard region support to block bounty collection in protected areas
- **Anti-self-farming** — you cannot collect bounties you placed yourself; same-IP kills are logged to console
- **Gamemode protection** — bounties can't be collected in Creative or Spectator
- **Actionbar reminders** — players with a bounty on their head are reminded periodically
- **Offline notifications** — missed messages are delivered when the player logs back in
- **Leaderboard** — track top bounty hunters by total earnings
- **Collection history** — paginated log of recent kills and payouts
- **Crossplay support** — Bedrock players tagged with [BE] via Floodgate
- **Persistent storage** — data saved to JSON files (bounties, history, leaderboard, notifications)
- **Auto-save** — data is saved every 5 minutes and on shutdown

---

## 📦 Requirements

| Dependency | Required? |
|---|---|
| [Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) | ✅ Required |
| [WorldGuard](https://enginehub.org/worldguard) | ⚡ Optional (safe zones) |
| [Floodgate](https://geysermc.org/download) | ⚡ Optional (Bedrock crossplay) |

---

## 🛠 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/bounty set <player> <amount>` | Place a bounty on a player | `bountyhunter.use` |
| `/bounty remove <player>` | Cancel your bounty (partial refund) | `bountyhunter.use` |
| `/bounty extend <player>` | Extend your bounty duration | `bountyhunter.use` |
| `/bounty list [page]` | View all active bounties | `bountyhunter.use` |
| `/bounty top` | View the hunter leaderboard | `bountyhunter.use` |
| `/bounty info <player>` | Detailed info on a player's bounties | `bountyhunter.use` |
| `/bounty history [page]` | Recent bounty collections | `bountyhunter.use` |
| `/bounty reload` | Reload the config | `bountyhunter.admin` |

---

## 🔑 Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `bountyhunter.use` | Everyone | Use all bounty commands |
| `bountyhunter.admin` | OP | Reload the config |
